name: Bard Harder!
source: BARD HARDER! is a tabletop-inspired visual novel game about saving your friends from the Big Bad Evil Guy by using your strongest weapon: romance! So brush up on your pick-up lines and prepare some sexy tunes…what’s the worst that could happen?
translation: 巴德更努力！是一款桌面风格的视觉小说游戏，讲述的是使用你最强的武器：浪漫，从大坏蛋手中拯救你的朋友！所以，复习一下你的搭讪台词，准备一些性感的曲调……最糟糕的情况是什么？
